texte.La vue d'ensemble ne mesure rien : elle: The overview measures nothing: it orients.
texte.La vérification démontre-t-elle que le s: Does the verification demonstrate that the system satisfies its requirements?
texte.La vérification est ce qui sépare une in: Verification is what separates an interface that was designed from an interface that works. The acceptance criteria and the results go into the technical documentation.
texte.Le # exige au moins une mesure par scéna: # requires at least one measure per scenario. A scenario with no measure is an identified risk that nothing oversees.
texte.Le # exige que la latence d'intervention: # requires the intervention latency to be specified, measured and verified. Without it, nothing says the measure chosen holds the deadline — the engine does not assume.
texte.Le # exige un délai de réaction PAR scén: # requires a reaction time PER scenario. It is what governs the choice of measure categories: without it, no choice can be justified.
texte.Le CSIRT désigné comme coordinateur ET l: The CSIRT designated as coordinator AND ENISA, SIMULTANEOUSLY, through the single reporting platform.
texte.Le CSIRT ou, selon le cas, l'autorité co: The CSIRT or, as the case may be, the competent authority
texte.Le SMQ est conforme aux exigences réglem: The QMS complies with the regulatory requirements, as this document breaks them down.
texte.Le bloc que le parcours attend. Il nomme: The block the path is waiting on. It names, below, exactly what it is missing.
texte.Le bloc que le parcours attend. La flèch: The block the path is waiting on. The arrow leads there, and the screen's banner names what it is missing.
texte.Le cadre de responsabilité de la directi: The accountability framework for management and staff.
texte.Le cadre est volontaire : il décrit des: The framework is voluntary: it describes outcomes, not imposed controls.
texte.Le cadre place GOVERN au-dessus des troi: The framework places GOVERN above the other three. The work on MEASURE and MANAGE is real, but nobody takes it up: this is coverage without governance, not lesser coverage.
texte.Le cadre se lit en profil, jamais en not: The framework is read as a profile, never as an overall mark.
texte.Le calendrier n'est pas négocié : il est: The timetable is not negotiated: it is set recommendation by recommendation.
texte.Le caractère ou l'importance systémique: The systemic character or importance of the financial entities that depend on the provider.
texte.Le certificat vit sur un cycle de trois: The certificate runs on a three-year cycle, with periodic audits.
texte.Le chemin pour les atteindre est-il plan: Is the path to reaching them planned — who, what, when, with what resources?
texte.Le chiffre d'affaires annuel mondial, et: The worldwide annual turnover, and the floor it sets on the fine ceiling.
The worldwide annual turnover, and the three fine tiers of article #.
texte.Le chiffre d'affaires retenu est celui r: The turnover taken is the one made IN THE UNION by supplying the financial entities of article #(#) of DORA with the ICT services listed by the implementing technical standards of article #(#).
texte.Le chiffre qui part en comité doit porte: A figure that goes to a committee must carry its reservation in the same block.
texte.Le choix n'est pas neutre : les deux der: The choice is not neutral: the last two approaches open a burden of proof the first two do not carry.
texte.Le cinquième risque paraissait n'avoir a: The fifth risk looked as though it had no action, when in fact it has four. An orphan risk on screen reads as « nothing to do », which is the opposite.
texte.Le comportement du système après une int: Is the system's behaviour after an intervention predictable, and are the gaps found documented and analysed in the technical documentation?
texte.Le contenu lu par le modèle — document,: The content the model reads — a document, a page, a ticket, a tool description — carries instructions that it executes as though they came from the user.
texte.Le contrat, la sortie, et ce qu'on fait: The contract, the exit, and what is done if the third party stops.
texte.Le coût est porté par l'exploitant et no: The cost is borne by the operator and not by the caller: nothing in normal use flags the abuse before the invoice does.
texte.Le coût n'est pas le sujet : une pratiqu: Cost is not the point: a prohibited practice is withdrawn, not optimised. The amount is shown because hiding it would make the row disappear from the table.
texte.Le dispositif du fournisseur suppose une: The provider's arrangement assumes an available person. A pace that leaves no time to examine produces passive acceptance whatever the design.
texte.Le document dit MAÎTRISÉS, pas absents :: The document says CONTROLLED, not absent: zero bias does not exist, and promising its absence is the commonest mistake.
texte.Le document emploie « confabulation » pl: The document uses « confabulation » rather than « hallucination »: the second term credits the system with an experience it does not have.
texte.Le document porte deux paragraphes du mê: The document carries two clauses with the same title, # and #: both are kept, told apart by their number.
texte.Le domaine d'application du SMSI (art. #: The scope of the ISMS (clause #), the acceptance criteria and their two dates, then each risk with its rating, the property affected and its owner.
texte.Le domaine d'application. Celui du systè: The scope. The management system's is chosen by the organisation; the Regulation's is not — it covers everything that supports critical or important functions. Carrying the first over as the second is the commonest mistake of this graft.
texte.Le déploiement est-il maîtrisé, et la ve: Is the deployment under control, and is the deployed version tied to its documentation?
texte.Le fabricant évalue, établit la document: The manufacturer assesses, draws up the technical documentation, signs the EU declaration of conformity and affixes the CE marking. No third party is involved.
texte.Le fournisseur a démontré sa supervision: The provider demonstrated its oversight for a given profile. A person less qualified than that profile invalidates the demonstration.
texte.Le fournisseur de modèle est un tiers co: The model provider is a third party like any other — except that it changes version without notice.
On the day it breaks, who does what.
texte.Le masquage en revue séquentielle est le: Blinding in a sequential review is the point most often missing: technically simple, it is almost always forgotten.
texte.Le matériel d'entraînement couvre-t-il l: Does the training material cover the limits and warnings, the way the basis on which outputs are computed can produce exceptional outputs, and — for a system that keeps learning — whether the oversight actions influence the learning or not?
texte.Le millésime # du Top # des applications: The # edition of the Top # for LLM-based applications, risk by risk.
texte.Le module ne l'ajoute pas au tableau : i: The module does not add it to the table: it flags it as a standard of the family this site already covers, saying that the link comes from the site and not from Annex B.
texte.Le modèle est normatif : la chaîne de so: The template is normative: the subcontracting chain is declared in a single format, comparable from one provider to another.
texte.Le modèle produit un contenu faux, prése: The model produces false content, delivered with confidence, which the system or the user adopts as its own.
texte.Le modèle rend des données qu'il n'aurai: The model returns data it should not have returned: personal data, secrets, another client's content.
texte.Le modèle, un adaptateur, une bibliothèq: The model, an adapter, a library or a data set arrives already compromised.
texte.Le montant des redevances de supervision: The amount of the oversight fees, their basis, their floor and their payment deadline.
texte.Le moteur PROPOSE : rien n'est écrit au: The engine PROPOSES: nothing is written to the register without a decision and the name of whoever took it.
texte.Le même volume déclaré donne le coût et: The same declared volume gives both the cost and the footprint: there is no keeping two inventories.
texte.Le niveau le plus exigeant du règlement,: The most demanding level of the Regulation, backed by a European cybersecurity certification scheme.
texte.Le nombre d'entités financières servies: The number of financial entities served and the total value of their assets.
texte.Le nombre d'établissements d'importance: The number of global or other systemically important institutions that depend on it, and their interdependence with other financial entities.
texte.Le paragraphe ne s'applique pas — et il: The clause does not apply — and you must be able to say why.
texte.Le pilier physique de l'approche tous ri: The physical pillar of the all-hazards approach: who gets in where, and what access to the premises reaches.
texte.Le plafond retenu est le plus élevé des: The ceiling applied is the higher of the two amounts.
texte.Le plan de sensibilisation, public par p: The awareness plan, audience by audience: the state of each action, chosen.
texte.Le plus tôt possible, et en tout état de: As early as possible, and in any event within four hours of the classification as major, and no more than twenty-four hours from becoming aware.
texte.Le point d'entrée du dispositif IA Act :: The entry point of the AI Act arrangement: map, classify, assess, document, prove.
texte.Le point d'entrée du dispositif RGPD, et: The entry point of the GDPR arrangement, and what each screen covers.
texte.Le pont dit où la norme s'arrête, pas qu: The bridge says where the standard stops, not that it is inadequate.
texte.Le prestataire notifie sa désignation au: The provider notifies its designation to the financial entities it supplies.
texte.Le prestataire peut adresser une déclara: The provider may submit a reasoned statement containing any information relevant to the assessment.
texte.Le prestataire vous notifie sa désignati: The provider notifies you of its designation as critical.
texte.Le périmètre de certification est exacte: The certification scope is exactly what caps the bridge: it is the first thing to measure, before relying on it.
texte.Le périmètre du SMSI n'est pas écrit. To: The ISMS scope is not written down. Anything not excluded in writing is audited — a vague scope is the first cause of audit-cost drift.
texte.Le périmètre du système de management es: The management system's scope is chosen by the organisation; the Regulation's is not. Carrying the first over as the second is the commonest mistake.
texte.Le périmètre exact des « dispositions pe: The exact scope of the « relevant provisions » that article #(#) of NIS # carves out is not listed by the text. The Commission guidelines provided for in paragraph # specify it; this module therefore tells what the text names from what is inferred.
texte.Le périmètre nomme-t-il les systèmes d'I: Does the scope name the AI systems covered — and does it say what is excluded from it, and why?
texte.Le recours à une prestation d'accompagne: The use of a security support and advisory service (PACS) qualified by ANSSI, under article # of Decree No #-# of # March # as amended
texte.Le registre d'informations de tous les a: The register of information on all contractual arrangements for ICT services, kept at individual, sub-consolidated and consolidated level.
texte.Le registre d'informations n'est pas une: The register of information is not a reporting formality: it is the raw material of the designation. An incomplete register distorts the assessment made of your suppliers.
texte.Le registre des produits comportant des: The register of products with digital elements, and the declared class of each.
texte.Le registre est la pièce que la CNIL dem: The register is the document the CNIL asks for first, and it feeds the DPIA and the map.
texte.Le registre vu d'ensemble : flux, catégo: The register seen as a whole: flows, categories, recipients.
texte.Le reste de l'audit — nécessaire, mais q: The rest of the audit — necessary, but not enough on its own to close off market access.
texte.Le risque le plus sous-estimé du lot : i: The most underestimated risk of the set: it covers over-reliance, confusion about who decides, and anthropomorphism.
texte.Le règlement regarde vos GESTES, pas vot: The Regulation looks at what you DO, not at your trade: the role governs the obligations.
texte.Le règlement relève le niveau d'harmonis: The Regulation raises the level of harmonisation and sets stricter requirements than the Union law in force on financial services, including those of Directive (EU) #/#. In relation to it, it is a lex specialis.
texte.Le référentiel fait office de preuve : c: The framework serves as the evidence: it is the least costly path through an inspection.
texte.Le référentiel ne l'attend pas de cette: The framework does not expect it of this entity.
texte.Le régime n'est pas déterminé : on ne sa: The regime is not determined: it is not known whether the full framework or the simplified framework of article # applies.
texte.Le rôle n'est pas qualifié ; le taux est: The role is not qualified; the rate is computed as though you were the manufacturer.
texte.Le score, ses plafonds, la documentation: The score, its caps, the documentation required and the coverage of article # subparagraph by subparagraph.
texte.Le secteur oriente vers le bon point de: The sector points to the right item in Annex III without ever deciding it on its own.
texte.Le secteur, la taille, et les portes de: The sector, the size, and the doors in article # that ignore size.
texte.Le service TIC fourni en définitive à l': The ICT service ultimately supplied in support of critical or important functions is of a critical nature for those entities' activities.
texte.Le seul des douze que la cyber couvre de: The only one of the twelve that cybersecurity covers end to end — and the one from which it is wrongly inferred that it covers the other eleven.
texte.Le socle : champ d'application, gestion: The baseline: scope, ICT risk management, incidents, testing, third-party providers. # articles.
texte.Le socle décide de ce que chaque famille: The baseline decides what each family must contain.
texte.Le socle retenu — Low, Moderate ou High: The baseline chosen — Low, Moderate or High — then the state of each of the eighteen control families.
texte.Le statut des fonctions d'intervention f: The status of the intervention functions is part of the oversight information: knowing that you can stop is a condition of stopping.
texte.Le superviseur principal applique ce sou: The lead overseer applies this sub-criterion from twenty-four months after DORA's entry into force (article # of the delegated act).
texte.Le superviseur principal détermine le no: The lead overseer determines the number of members and the composition, in agreement with the joint oversight network and in consultation with the Oversight Forum of article #(#).
texte.Le superviseur principal notifie au pres: The lead overseer notifies the provider of the outcome of the assessment carried out with a view to designation.
texte.Le superviseur principal rend PUBLIC le: The lead overseer makes PUBLIC any case where a provider does not reply, or replies insufficiently — disclosing its identity, and the type and nature of the failure.
texte.Le superviseur principal tient compte de: The lead overseer takes the statement into account and may ask for further information.
texte.Le système authentifie-t-il chaque révis: Does the system authenticate each reviewer with individual credentials, prevent one and the same account from reviewing the same output twice, blind the first reviewer's decision from the second in a sequential review, and record each action separately?
texte.Le système bouge ; la mesure d'hier ne v: The system moves; yesterday's measurement no longer holds.
texte.Le système de gestion des risques de l'a: Is the risk management system of article # in place, and are its actions taken up in the product's development?
texte.Le système de management est-il amélioré: Is the management system improved on the basis of what the review and the monitoring return?
texte.Le système de management produit déjà l': The management system already produces the artefact the article calls for. What remains is to check its scope.
texte.Le système distingue-t-il au minimum les: Does the system distinguish at least the states « review required », « review completed » and « rejected », and is access to the review interface limited to authenticated accounts?
texte.Le système déclaré est un composant de s: The declared system is a safety component of a product covered by the harmonisation legislation in Annex I, or is itself such a product.
texte.Le système empêche-t-il TECHNIQUEMENT un: Does the system TECHNICALLY prevent an identification output from triggering an action, an automated decision or a transmission before the reviews by two separate natural persons are recorded?
texte.Le système est déclaré génératif : le ta: The system is declared generative: the rate is the framework's, CAPPED by the AI #-# profile.
texte.Le système est-il génératif, lesquels de: Whether the system is generative, which of the twelve risks apply, and which of the # suggested actions of §# are met.
texte.Le système interagit directement avec de: The system interacts directly with people, or produces synthetic content, without otherwise falling under Annex III or Annex I.
texte.Le système met-il en œuvre au moins une: Does the system implement at least one function among disregard, override and revert, PLUS the means to shut the system down or switch it to a safe degraded mode — and is the latency specified, measured and verified as compatible with the reaction time?
texte.Le système notifie la personne désignée: The system alerts the designated person when it enters a state calling for human attention or intervention; the person perceives, assesses, then intervenes.
texte.Le système, sa documentation et le matér: Do the system, its documentation and the mandatory training material allow the designated persons to understand how the system works, what it can do and where its limits lie, and are the competences you assume DECLARED in the instructions?
texte.Le tableau de bord qui consolide le regi: The dashboard that consolidates the register, the DPIA, privacy by design, the documentation and the awareness work.
texte.Le tableau ne liste PAS prEN #-# (superv: The table does NOT list prEN #-# (human oversight). It files articles # to # under prEN #-#.
